title: Insecure Communication
description: Control and telemetry links transmitted without confidentiality or integrity, allowing interception, modification, or injection of commands and video.
impact: Loss of control, mission-data interception, command injection.
realExample: MAVLink sends unencrypted messages by default; DJI DroneID broadcasts unencrypted pilot location (NDSS 2023).

title: Weak Authentication & Authorization
description: Default credentials, missing authentication, or exposed debug services that allow unauthorized control of the airframe or its services.
impact: Hijacking, unauthorized control, full system compromise.
realExample: Unauthenticated Telnet root on consumer UAVs (CVE-2024-6422); Holy Stone Remote ID unauthenticated power-off (CVE-2024-52876).

title: Insecure Firmware & Software
description: Memory-corruption bugs, unsigned updates, and exposed debug interfaces enabling persistent compromise.
impact: Code execution, persistent backdoors, key extraction.
realExample: DJI Mavic 3 vtwo_sdk memory corruption via DUML fuzzing (CVE-2023-51454/55/56, NDSS 2023).

title: GPS / GNSS Spoofing
description: Civil GNSS signals are unencrypted and weak (~-130 dBm) and can be overpowered to mislead navigation.
impact: Capture, mission failure, geofence bypass, delivery theft.
realExample: UT Austin demonstrated capture of a civilian UAV via GPS spoofing; consumer airframes remain broadly susceptible.

title: Insufficient Network Security
description: Onboard network services (FTP, Telnet, RTSP, debug HTTP) exposed without hardening.
impact: Service abuse, data theft, pivot to flight controller.
realExample: Open RTSP video and Telnet on the airframe AP (see CVE-2024-6422).

title: Inadequate Data Protection
description: Flight logs, media, and configuration stored or transmitted without encryption.
impact: Disclosure of operator location, routes, and captured media.
realExample: Recoverable flight logs and media after unauthenticated shell access.

title: Lack of Secure Update Mechanism
description: Updates delivered without signature verification or downgrade protection.
impact: Malicious or downgraded firmware, persistent compromise.
realExample: Firmware downgrade to a vulnerable build to re-enable a patched flaw.

title: Insecure Third-Party Components
description: Vulnerable SDKs, libraries, or RF modules inherited into the airframe.
realExample: Vulnerable Remote ID modules sourced across vendors (CVE-2024-52876).

title: Physical & Remote ID Weaknesses
description: Accessible debug headers and spoofable or DoS-able Remote ID broadcasts.
impact: Firmware extraction, identity spoofing, Remote ID denial.
realExample: Remote ID power-off via BLE (CVE-2024-52876); spoofable Open Drone ID broadcasts.

title: Insufficient Logging & Monitoring
description: No tamper-evident logging of control events, making intrusions and spoofing invisible after the fact.
realExample: Spoofing and command injection leave no airframe-side record.
